negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language queries on банкомати / ПОС терминали / платен систем + тендер returned the ESJN portal, the Public Procurement Law and unrelated commercial POS pages, but no concrete notice. This reflects search-engine coverage of the ASP.NET portal, not absence of such tenders.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that keyword discovery via general web search is not viable for this cell — the collector must query ESJN/TED directly by CPV code and contracting authority, not rely on search engines.

negative_findings.description: Numerous commercial tender aggregators (tenderinfo.org, tenderdetail.com, globaltenders.com, tenderimpulse.com, tendersontime.com, gtbc.net, developmentaid.org) claim North Macedonia coverage.
negative_findings.result_summary: These were seen in results but not adopted as candidates: they are paywalled, of unverified completeness, republish official data, and their terms typically forbid systematic reuse.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Tempting shortcuts that would introduce licensing risk and unverifiable provenance into a source register whose value depends on primary-source traceability. DevelopmentAid is the least objectionable for IFI forecast notices but still paywalled.

negative_findings.description: Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette) as a secondary publication channel for procurement notices was noted but not directly assessed.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Public Procurement Law text indicates notices may be published in ЕСЈН and/or the Official Gazette, with above-threshold notices also in the EU Official Journal. The Gazette's own portal was not fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Gazette is the authoritative legal record and the place where the regulatory obligation behind a tender is actually promulgated; it should be scouted as a companion source in a later pass.

negative_findings.description: No AML/sanctions-screening vendor announcement naming a specific North Macedonian bank was found, in either English or Macedonian, despite AML being an explicit EU-accession compliance driver.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only generic global AML-vendor listicles, a MONEYVAL 2025 review summary, and the MBA AML commission page — no vendor press release or case study naming an MK bank customer.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: AML screening is one of the mandates most likely to be procured under NDA; if vendors never publish MK references, the pointer strategy for this specific mandate fails and coverage must shift to conference speaker lists, job ads and regulator enforcement notices.

negative_findings.description: No private-sector tender aggregator carrying MK bank RFPs was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian-language tender searches returned only the state e-Nabavki (ESJN) portal, the Public Procurement Law, ministry pages and the EU TED platform. No commercial MK aggregator publishing private-company RFPs surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: private MK bank buying leaves no tender trace at all, so vendor announcements and trade press are the only route — a structural, not a search-depth, limitation.

negative_findings.description: No North Macedonia customer reference was found for the major global core-banking and ATM vendors (Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Finastra, Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos).
negative_findings.result_summary: Targeted English search returned only Wikipedia bank profiles; no vendor page, case study or press release tied any of these vendors to an MK bank.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests MK core-banking estates are either legacy in-house, served by regional players (ASEE) rather than tier-1 global vendors, or covered by confidentiality — an important shaping assumption for the whole workstream that should be tested directly on each vendor's site rather than via search engines.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language vendor-marketing vocabulary is thin: most MK IT suppliers publish case studies in English only, and Albanian-language coverage was not attempted in this cell.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK queries surfaced news media and regulators far more readily than vendor case studies; the productive MK terms were journalistic ('лансираше', 'имплементираше', 'соработка') rather than procurement terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection rules should search MK for trade press and EN for vendor sites, and a follow-up run should add Albanian (sq) terms given the Albanian-language segment of the MK market.

negative_findings.description: Two candidate URLs were inferred from vendor branding rather than confirmed by a fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: nextsense.com and payten.com/en/news-events/ were not directly fetched in this run; the underlying companies are confirmed to exist and be active in/around MK, but the exact canonical paths must be checked by the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a broken entry point being treated as a live source.

negative_findings.description: English-language search for current compliance/AML vacancies at Skopje banks ('compliance officer AML job Skopje bank vacancy 2026') returned essentially no MK-specific results — hits were South African, Indian, UK and Kosovo boards.
negative_findings.result_summary: Generic international job aggregators dominate; no MK bank vacancy surfaced in English.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that hiring-signal collection for MK MUST run on Macedonian-language terms and on local boards; an English-only pipeline for this cell would be near-blind.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated events/seminars calendar page was located on mba.mk (Macedonian Banking Association) during this run; only news and tag pages surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Association seminar agendas — the highest-value artefact for this cell — could not be confirmed as published on a public page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MBA training may be members-only or communicated by e-mail, meaning the strongest early-warning artefact may not be publicly collectable and would need a proxy (ABIT, Chamber, press coverage).

negative_findings.description: Finelevate Digital Summit 2026 (Skopje, 16 Sept 2026) and MicroBalkans 2026 are described in MK press, but their official event domains were not identified in this run; EACHA's official domain is inferred from the organisation name only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three high-value agenda sources exist as press descriptions without a confirmed canonical URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Agendas and speaker lists are the payload; without the canonical site the run can only harvest second-hand summaries. Domain resolution should be a follow-up task, not an invented URL.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn job search and company employee data are behind a login wall and prohibited by ToS for automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: The richest structured hiring-signal source cannot be legally scraped.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any hiring-trend quantification must rely on MK job boards plus manual LinkedIn review, which limits statistical claims about posting volume.

negative_findings.description: No Macedonian chapter or MK-localised certification body for ACAMS/ICA-style AML certification, and no MK certification announcements register, was found with the queries run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Certification signal for MK appears to run through international bodies and individual employer press releases rather than a national registry.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Certification-announcement tracking for MK will have to be person-level (press releases, LinkedIn) rather than registry-level, which is weaker and slower.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) search was run, although Albanian is a widely used official language in North Macedonia and some institutions publish vacancies in it.
negative_findings.result_summary: sq-language hiring and training ads were not covered; the run scope named mk and en only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A share of PSP/bank branch and training announcements in western MK may be missed entirely.

negative_findings.description: Searched in mk and en for a dedicated financial-services ombudsman / out-of-court dispute-resolution body for banking and payments in North Macedonia. Nothing of that kind surfaced; the ОПМ description of the grievance path routes financial complaints to NBRM (banks/savings houses), Ministry of Finance (financial companies), the Insurance Supervision Agency, and the State Market Inspectorate.
negative_findings.result_summary: No sector-specific financial ombudsman identified; grievance handling appears split across the sectoral supervisors plus the general Народен правобранител.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means there is no single ADR docket to monitor; complaint intelligence must be assembled from NBRM's aggregate complaints report, the general Ombudsman, and the courts.

negative_findings.description: Attempts to reach a keyword-searchable database of Управен суд / Виш управен суд judgments on banking or payment fees returned only WebSphere portal landing pages with opaque /wps/portal/ !ut/p/ URLs and no visible full-text search over judgments.
negative_findings.result_summary: Administrative court case law appears not to be exposed as a queryable, enumerable corpus on the open web.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's highest-value signal — rulings that name the specific provision under stress — may only be reachable by browser navigation, by Freedom-of-Information request, or indirectly via legal media such as Правдико.

negative_findings.description: An English search result titled 'Court Blocks Bank Fees, Empowers Consumers' on athens-times.com surfaced. It was not fetched or corroborated, and its relationship to North Macedonia (as opposed to Greece or another jurisdiction) is unestablished.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as an unverified lead only; deliberately NOT entered as a candidate source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Aggregator headlines about court rulings on bank fees are exactly the kind of item that gets miscountried; it needs verification against a primary court source before use.

negative_findings.description: www.nbrm.mk returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a direct fetch of the consumer-information page. The site is indexed and returns rich search results, so this is a bot-defence hypothesis, not evidence the resource is unavailable.
negative_findings.result_summary: NBRM pages recorded as blocked=true with blocker_type http_403_bot_defence; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for the highest-priority source in this cell must budget for a headless-browser or authenticated-UA fetch path.

negative_findings.description: Run scope specified languages mk and en only. No searches were run in Albanian (sq), despite North Macedonia having a substantial Albanian-speaking population and institutions publishing bilingually (e.g. the State Audit Office masthead includes 'Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit').
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian-language grievance and consumer-organisation channels are unexplored in this slice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Regional consumer organisations (Tetovo, Kičevo) and their complaint output may publish primarily in Albanian and would be missed entirely.

negative_findings.description: Searched in both Macedonian and English for an RSS/Atom feed or e-mail alert subscription on nbrm.mk (соопштенија, вести, претплата, е-пошта; 'RSS feed announcements National Bank North Macedonia decisions'). No feed URL surfaced in results and the site could not be crawled directly for <link rel=alternate> tags because of a 403.
negative_findings.result_summary: No confirmed RSS/Atom or mailing-list endpoint for NBRM announcements. Unresolved, not disproven — the .nspx CMS may still expose one at an unadvertised path.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a push feed, A3 monitoring of the single most important MK regulator must fall back to polling + archive diffing, which is more fragile and more likely to miss a short consultation deadline.

negative_findings.description: https://www.nbrm.mk/statistika-en.nspx returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to the agent's fetcher while the domain is well indexed and serves content to browsers.
negative_findings.result_summary: nbrm.mk is bot-defended, not dead. HYPOTHESIS: WAF or user-agent filtering.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The whole nbrm.mk document estate — the core of this cell — may need browser-context or UA-spoofed collection; a naive verifier could wrongly mark dozens of critical URLs as dead.

negative_findings.description: https://data.gov.mk/ returned connect ECONNREFUSED 95.180.140.102:443 on a single attempt.
negative_findings.result_summary: National open data portal unreachable in this run; API family (CKAN vs DKAN vs custom) therefore unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The portal's API shape determines whether financial-sector datasets can be harvested cheaply; this must be re-probed before the collection method for that source is fixed.

negative_findings.description: web.archive.org is not fetchable from this agent's WebFetch tool ('Claude Code is unable to fetch from web.archive.org'), so no CDX result set could be enumerated for nbrm.mk or slvesnik.com.mk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Actual archive coverage depth for MK regulator domains is UNMEASURED in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The central premise of this cell — that archives preserve the version history of silently-replaced regulator pages — is unverified for these specific domains; a JS-heavy .nspx CMS may be poorly captured, in which case the run needs its own snapshotting rather than relying on Wayback.

negative_findings.description: The statutory Register of Payment Institutions kept by the National Bank (Регистар на платежни институции, a public book in electronic form under the Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи) was confirmed to exist in law, but Macedonian-language searching surfaced Bulgarian BNB registers instead and did not return the MK register's own landing URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register existence confirmed from statute; canonical URL not found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For payments-sector A3 this register is a top-tier entity feed; leaving its URL unknown is a concrete, closable gap.

negative_findings.description: The Macedonian query for payment-service-provider registers was dominated by Bulgarian National Bank pages (BNB uses near-identical Cyrillic terminology: 'регистър на доставчици на платежни услуги' vs MK 'регистар на даватели на платежни услуги').
negative_findings.result_summary: Cross-language Cyrillic contamination between BG and MK financial terminology is a systematic noise source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated MK query must be domain-pinned (site:.mk / site:nbrm.mk) or it will silently harvest Bulgarian regulation and mislabel it as MK — a correctness risk for A3 conclusions.

negative_findings.description: Службен весник offers a free-issue tier, but structured search, consolidated texts and the full back-catalogue are positioned as a subscription product of the publishing public enterprise.
negative_findings.result_summary: Free PDF issue access appears available; systematic search over the gazette likely requires a paid subscription.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines whether gazette monitoring can be fully automated at zero cost or needs a licence line-item; also affects legal reuse posture.

negative_findings.description: Searched in both mk and en for a structured, machine-readable bill-tracking portal for the Assembly of RNM (an 'e-Sobranie' / e-democracy legislative tracker with per-bill status, sponsor and stage). Local-language queries around 'предлог закони во собраниска процедура' and English queries around 'e-demokratija / eSobranie / legislation tracker' returned only the general sobranie.mk .nspx pages and third-party guides.
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated open bill-tracker or API was found. Bill tracking appears to require scraping sobranie.mk session/committee pages (sessiondetails.nspx) and joining them to ЕНЕР and vlada.mk session readouts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bill-stage tracking for banking and payments statutes will need a bespoke, brittle scraper across three sites rather than one feed, raising build cost and the risk of missing a fast-tracked amendment (скратена/итна постапка).

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed, bulk download or API was identified for Службен весник issues, in either language. The publisher site itself could not be fetched (TLS chain error) so the presence of a free structured index remains unverified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Gazette monitoring must be assumed to be HTML/PDF scraping of the issue index, or purchase of the publisher's subscription database.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The gazette is the legally binding trigger for every deadline in this cell; without a feed, latency and completeness depend entirely on our own polling cadence.

negative_findings.description: Searched in mk for a separate 'Закон за електронски пари' / 'издавачи на електронски пари'. Results consistently point instead to e-money being regulated inside the Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи (Сл. весник 90 од 12.4.2022, in application from 1.1.2023), which transposes PSD2 and the e-money directives.
negative_findings.result_summary: No standalone e-money act found; e-money institutions (институции за електронски пари) are authorised under the payment services law.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a false coverage gap: monitoring should key on the payment-services statute and its amendments rather than hunting a non-existent e-money act.

negative_findings.description: Four target pages resisted automated fetching in this pass: slvesnik.com.mk (TLS 'unable to verify the first certificate'), sobranie.mk (HTTP 403 on the root), guides.loc.gov (HTTP 403), and an ENER deep link Default.aspx?...itemid=77045 (HTTP 404 despite being indexed with a title).
negative_findings.result_summary: All four are recorded as unverified/blocked hypotheses, not dead. The 403s look like bot defence; the TLS error looks like an incomplete intermediate chain; the ENER 404 looks like a state-dependent ASP.NET deep link.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection layer for this cell must use a browser-grade fetcher (real user-agent, relaxed-but-logged TLS handling, session cookies) rather than a plain HTTP client, or the highest-value sources will look unreachable.

negative_findings.description: Third-party monitoring (Огледало на Владата / MCIC / CRC) reports that only about 51% of draft laws adopted by the Government and sent to Parliament in 2023 were published on ЕНЕР, and that ministries answered roughly 20% of submitted comments.
negative_findings.result_summary: ЕНЕР cannot be treated as a complete census of forthcoming statutes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Roughly half of banking/payments/AML bills may reach Parliament with no prior consultation footprint, so vlada.mk session readouts and Собрание agendas must be monitored independently rather than as confirmation of an ЕНЕР hit.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian for a UJP-published register/list of approved fiscal device types and manufacturers ('одобрени фискални апарати список производители одобрение'). Results were dominated by Bulgarian registers (НАП/БИМ) and returned no MK list.
negative_findings.result_summary: No MK approved-fiscal-device register located in this pass; however the UJP regulation register does contain a 'Правилник за регистарот на одобрени фискални системи' (effective 08.04.2016), so a register almost certainly exists somewhere on ujp.gov.mk or in the Gazette.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The approved-device register is the single most commercially relevant list for POS/fiscal hardware vendors; missing it leaves a hole in competitor and certification tracking.

negative_findings.description: Cyrillic queries about fiscal devices retrieved predominantly Bulgarian-language results because 'фискални устройства/апарати' terminology is shared across bg and mk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query needs MK-disambiguating tokens ('Северна Македонија', 'УЈП', 'фискална апаратура', 'готовински плаќања') or a site: filter on ujp.gov.mk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without disambiguation, automated MK collection will ingest Bulgarian regulatory content and produce false compliance signals.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public-consultation ('јавна расправа' / 'предлог акти') landing page was located on ufr.gov.mk, azlp.mk or kzk.gov.mk within this pass; ASO was the only cell authority whose regulation section was described as including public-consultation acts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Consultation signals for UFR/AZLP/KZK likely surface only via ENER or the Gazette rather than on the authorities' own sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Consultations is a named topic for this run; if the authorities do not publish drafts themselves, ENER becomes a single point of failure for early warning.

negative_findings.description: Searched mk for AZLP decisions concerning banks. Found training/news items and general guidance, but no searchable database of AZLP supervisory decisions or fines.
negative_findings.result_summary: AZLP appears to publish news and guidance rather than a structured decision register; individual decisions may only be discoverable via news items or FOI.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a decision register, enforcement-trend analysis for data protection in banking must rely on news scraping, which is lossy.

negative_findings.description: The data protection authority appears under two names: the historical 'Дирекција за заштита на личните податоци' (Directorate) and the current 'Агенција за заштита на личните податоци' (АЗЛП).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both names must be in the glossary; older documents and third-party references use 'Дирекција'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Name-based monitoring keyed only to 'Агенција' will miss the pre-rename corpus and citations.

negative_findings.description: No public, structured EU- or MK-side tracker was found that maps individual EU financial-services acts (PSD2, CRR/CRD, Solvency II, MiFID II, DGSD, IFR) to their MK transposing act with dates. The information exists but is scattered across the NPAA, screening report and per-law conformity statements.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for a transposition tracker returned only narrative documents, not a machine-readable correspondence table.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any deadline register for MK financial regulation must be assembled by parsing the NPAA and Sobranie conformity statements; no ready-made feed exists to subscribe to.

negative_findings.description: The Macedonian-language query on the EC report and Chapter 9 returned the reports themselves but no MK-language page devoted specifically to Chapter 9 / financial services within the negotiating structure (working group composition, chapter negotiating position).
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language results were dominated by general NPAA and country-report pages; the Chapter 9 working group was not surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The chapter working group and its negotiating position would be the highest-value MK-side document for regulatory deadlines; its absence from search may mean it is unpublished or buried behind mep.gov.mk site navigation.

negative_findings.description: The TAIEX database itself was not fetched; the July 2026 NBRM independence mission was learned about only via secondary local media reporting.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public listing of TAIEX missions for MK financial institutions could not be confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If TAIEX listings are gated, MK-side institutional newsrooms and local media become the only practical detector of these missions.

negative_findings.description: The ASO fintech-strategy PDF URL was taken from a search result and its filename appears garbled in transcription; it has not been fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: Document confirmed to exist ('Финтек-стратегија за финансиски регулатори, 2023-2027', hosted on aso.mk) but exact path is unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification must resolve the path from aso.mk rather than trusting the recorded URL.

negative_findings.description: No evidence of a national/domestic card scheme (a Macedonian-branded card scheme with its own scheme rulebook) was found. Searches in Macedonian for 'национална картична шема / домашна картична схема' returned nothing; CaSys appears as a processor and card-system operator for international schemes (Visa/Mastercard) rather than a domestic brand owner.
negative_findings.result_summary: Cell hypothesis of a 'national card scheme' is unsupported by evidence found in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids building a monitoring stream for an actor that may not exist; redirects effort to CaSys and the international scheme rulebooks as the real card rule-setters.

negative_findings.description: No publicly posted KIBS participation criteria / admission rulebook page or tariff schedule was located as a distinct, navigable page; only a single 'PravilaZaRabota.pdf' surfaced via the search index, and no tariff (тарифник) document was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: KIBS document tree is not exposed via an obvious public 'Documents' section.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Participation criteria and pricing are core cell content; if they are participant-only, collection must rely on regulator filings and bank T&C restatements instead.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public-consultation portal for draft NBRSM decisions on payment systems (предлог одлуки / јавна расправа with comment submission) was identified; only finalised 'Одлуки' and 'Подзаконски акти' index pages were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Consultations topic is weakly covered for this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Consultations are one of the run's four topics; if drafts are not published, early-warning must come from the National Payment System Council and the banking association instead.

negative_findings.description: A direct WebFetch of https://www.nbrm.mk/makiedonska_platiezhna_infrastruktura.nspx returned HTTP 403. This is treated as a hypothesis of bot defence, not as evidence the page is dead — the same site's URLs appear healthy in the search index.
negative_findings.result_summary: nbrm.mk requires browser-like fetching.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The entire regulator/operator backbone of this cell lives on nbrm.mk; the collector must use a browser-grade fetcher or it will record false negatives across the board.

negative_findings.description: The CaSys corporate domain (casys.com.mk) was inferred rather than confirmed; only third-party listings (LinkedIn, MASIT member directory) were observed directly in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: CaSys primary web presence needs resolution before collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: CaSys is the domestic card rule-setter for this cell; an unresolved primary domain leaves a hole in card-side rule monitoring.

negative_findings.description: www.nbrm.mk returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain WebFetch of the PI/EMI/PSO hub page.
negative_findings.result_summary: No page content retrieved; register contents could not be read directly in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important domain in this cell is bot-defended, so the pipeline must use a browser-grade fetcher. This is a hypothesis about bot defence, not evidence the page is dead.

negative_findings.description: finance.gov.mk registers page failed with ECONNREFUSED on port 443.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ministry of Finance register hub could not be enumerated; sub-register URLs for financial companies remain unknown.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The MoF-supervised financial-company perimeter is a real gap in the register map; needs a retry from a different egress before any conclusion.

negative_findings.description: No search result surfaced a confirmed official domain for Фонд за осигурување на депозити; the URL recorded is an inference and the seed term 'fosigurad.mk' returned nothing authoritative.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deposit Insurance Fund membership list located conceptually but not by verified URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Membership list is a valuable independent cross-check on the bank/savings-house licence register; the correct domain must be resolved before collection.

negative_findings.description: A dedicated landing URL for the 'Регистар на платежни институции' (as distinct from the e-money register and the payment-system-operator register) was not surfaced by either MK or EN queries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the hub page and the EMI/PSO register pages were located by URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The payment-institution register is the core artefact of this cell; its exact URL must be recovered by crawling the hub page with a browser-grade fetcher.

negative_findings.description: No evidence was found of an open-data/API or CSV endpoint for any NBRNM supervised-entity register; everything observed is HTML pages plus occasional XLS/PDF attachments.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection will require HTML/attachment parsing rather than API ingestion.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines collector design and diffing strategy; also means register history is likely not archived by the regulator.

negative_findings.description: For Halkbank AD Skopje no dedicated announcements/notices index page was surfaced by MK-language search; only tariff and documents/forms pages were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched 'halkbank.mk соопштенија известување измена на општи услови применува од' — results returned product and document pages only. Not verified as absent; the site may host notices behind an unindexed .nspx path or inside PDFs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the larger banks in the cell may need PDF-diff monitoring of tariff/terms documents rather than a notice feed.

negative_findings.description: Fetch of https://www.unibank.com.mk/ returned no output; the working UNIBanka domain observed in search results is unibank.mk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as a hypothesis, not a verdict — unibank.com.mk may be bot-defended, parked, or a redirect. Candidate recorded against unibank.mk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Domain ambiguity would break automated collection for this issuer if the wrong host is configured.

negative_findings.description: Fetch of the Sparkasse Bank homepage returned navigation without resolvable URLs for news, notices, tariffs or reports; the announcements path was recovered only via site-scoped search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Homepage rendering is JS-dependent; the dated /mk/soopshtenija/ path was confirmed indirectly through search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collector must seed the announcements path directly rather than crawl from the homepage.

negative_findings.description: https://www.mse.mk/mk/issuers/all returned HTTP 404; no complete listed-issuer index URL was confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Individual issuer slugs were confirmed (komercijalna-banka-ad-skopje, unibanka-ad-skopje, centralna-kooperativna-banka-ad-skopje) but the enumeration endpoint was not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without the index, the bank issuer universe must be seeded manually or derived from the supervisor's licensed-bank list.

negative_findings.description: No cross-bank aggregator of customer notices / general-terms amendments with effective dates was found for MK in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in mk and en returned only per-bank pages plus trade press; no consumer-protection or association-run consolidated register surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank-level effective-date tracking must be built as N per-bank collectors; there is no single upstream feed to lean on.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching surfaced almost nothing cell-specific: EN queries mostly returned Wikipedia entity pages, not bank notices or filings.
negative_findings.result_summary: Practically all usable artefacts (соопштенија, известувања, тарифник, Извештај и податоци за Банката, СЕИ-Нет filings) exist only in Macedonian.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An English-only collector for this cell would be near-empty; MK keyword sets are mandatory.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated fintech/payments trade association exists as an overarching body in North Macedonia. A comparative legal guide states there is no overarching trade association for the fintech sector; the closest organised bodies are the Association of Financial Companies (AFD/AFSANM, alternative lending) and the Chamber's Grouping of Non-Bank Financial Companies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in both mk and en for a payments/fintech association; only non-bank-lending and ICT bodies surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payment institutions and e-money institutions have no single collective voice, so their reactions to draft payment rules must be tracked institution-by-institution or via MBA/MASIT/AFD proxies.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, indexed 'position papers' or 'коментари на нацрт закони' section was located on mba.mk. The site's visible structure is За нас / Активности / SKIBOR / Финансиска едукација / Фондација; positions appear to be embedded in news items (соопштенија) rather than a document library.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetched mba.mk members page and reviewed site sections; no consultations/position archive observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be full-text over the news stream rather than a targeted document feed, and older positions may be unrecoverable.

negative_findings.description: Canonical homepages for two chambers were not directly confirmed: Стопанска комора на северо-западна Македонија (inferred oemvp.org from the published info@oemvp.org address; oemvp.eu also appears in circulation) and Сојуз на стопански комори (inferred chamber.mk from its official Facebook handle; the seeded 'sso.mk' returned nothing).
negative_findings.result_summary: Only business-registry profiles (zk.mk, companywall.com.mk) and social profiles were retrieved, not the organisations' own sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two significant pointer sources are recorded at low confidence and need a manual URL confirmation pass before scheduled collection.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) search terms were used in this pass, although the north-western chamber serves a largely Albanian-language business community and likely publishes in sq.
negative_findings.result_summary: Run scope specified mk and en only; sq association material therefore not searched.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Positions of Albanian-language business associations on draft financial rules may be entirely missed.

negative_findings.description: mchamber.mk serves the same content under two hosts (mchamber.mk and mchamber.org.mk) and under both modern paths (/mk/home/propisi_info/ID) and legacy ASPX query strings with embedded ASP.NET session tokens (e.g. (S(skf2aj...))). fic.mk shows the same ASPX pattern.
negative_findings.result_summary: Observed in multiple search results; not tested for canonicalisation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Session-bearing URLs are unstable and will produce duplicate or dead records unless normalised at collection time.

negative_findings.description: Targeted enumeration for a Macedonian 'Banker'-style outlet at banker.mk and for profit.com.mk returned no results; the closest actual equivalents are bankarstvo.mk and pari.com.mk.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence found that banker.mk or profit.com.mk exist as active MK banking outlets; do not record them as sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief names 'Bankarstvo/Banker-type outlets' — this pins the real domain (bankarstvo.mk) and prevents a fabricated banker.mk entry entering the registry.

negative_findings.description: Local-language searches on supervisory sanction terms (казна, супервизорска мерка) returned NBRM primary regulation and Wikipedia rather than press reporting of specific fines or measures against named banks.
negative_findings.result_summary: No press article documenting a concrete supervisory sanction was retrieved in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either MK press rarely reports individual supervisory measures (a real intelligence limitation for A3), or the search index under-covers these outlets. Needs a dedicated enforcement-focused pass, ideally via time.mk site search.

negative_findings.description: Explicit site-scoped queries for fokus.mk and slobodenpecat.mk on banking-regulation terms returned no articles from those domains.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both outlets remain unverified for this topic; recorded with low confidence rather than dropped.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A search-engine blind spot must not be mistaken for absence of coverage; a direct on-site search pass is required before ranking these outlets.

negative_findings.description: No feed endpoints (RSS/Atom) were confirmed for any outlet in this cell; suggested collection methods assume a feed exists but this was not tested.
negative_findings.result_summary: Feed availability unknown for all 17 candidates.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design (feed polling vs HTML crawl vs aggregator-mediated) hinges on this and should be resolved in the technical verification pass.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact index URLs for several NBRM instrument families (супервизорски циркулари/известувања до банките, decisions on accounting & financial reporting, methodology/rulebook annexes) were not individually confirmed — only individual act pages were seen.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do one browser-grade crawl of https://www.nbrm.mk/bankarska_supervizija_i_rieghulativa.nspx and enumerate every child link into the source registry.

coverage_gaps.description: Pre-adoption visibility for NBRM bylaws is unconfirmed; ENER coverage of central-bank secondary acts (as opposed to ministry laws) was not verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted ENER search filtered to NBRM as proponent, and check whether NBRM publishes drafts under press releases; if neither, record consultations as structurally unobservable in MK and document the workaround.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language publication by NBRM was not investigated in this pass, despite Albanian being an official language in North Macedonia.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check for an '-al'/'sq' variant of nbrm.mk pages; if none exists, record it as a finding that MK is the only local-language channel.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical archive depth of NBRM decisions (whether superseded versions remain retrievable) is unknown; consolidated 'пречистен текст' PDFs appear to be overwritten in place.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish hash-based snapshotting from first collection, and check for a Wayback presence of /content/Regulativa/ PDFs to reconstruct past versions.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed way to search the Official Gazette by issuing authority ('Народна банка') was found, which would let A3 catch NBRM acts the bank's own site is slow to post.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test slvesnik.com.mk search capabilities (and the mobile app / euslugi portal) for issuer or full-text search; evaluate subscription value.

coverage_gaps.description: The entire nbrm.mk source family — the cell's centre of gravity — is unreachable by the tooling available in this run (403 WAF).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a headless-browser (Playwright) fetcher with realistic browser fingerprint and polite rate limiting to the MK collector, and re-probe every nbrm.mk URL in this slice before marking any of them dead. Alternatively enquire whether NBRM offers an email subscription / RSS for соопштенија.

coverage_gaps.description: The ENER browse/listing and search routes were not captured — only individual item-detail URLs are known. Without the listing route we cannot enumerate open consultations or read comment deadlines systematically.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: One browser session on https://ener.gov.mk/ to record the listing/search request (parameters, paging, filter-by-ministry) and the detail-page DOM for the deadline field; then template a parser.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent MK financial regulators that also consult on drafts were out of this cell's scope and were not scouted: Комисија за хартии од вредност (SEC), Агенција за супервизија на осигурување (ASO), МАПАС (pensions), Управа за финансиско разузнавање (FIU/AML), Комисија за заштита на конкуренцијата (interchange/competition).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign a sibling cell to cover non-NBRM MK financial regulators, especially the FIU for AML rulebooks and the SEC where payments/fintech licensing overlaps.

coverage_gaps.description: No official NBRM RSS/Atom feed, e-mail alert list, or open-data/API endpoint for regulation was identified, and no NBRM Official-Gazette-linked machine-readable register was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe conventional feed paths on nbrm.mk from a browser context and check the site footer for a newsletter subscription; if none exists, fall back to scheduled diffing plus the media/social mirrors listed as candidates.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/backfill strategy was established for withdrawn or superseded drafts; NBRM republishes consolidated texts in place ('пречистен текст'), so prior versions and their transition deadlines silently disappear.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair the collector with Wayback Machine snapshots of nbrm.mk/regulativa.nspx and the payments regulation hub, and hash-archive every PDF at first sight.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage was not attempted, although Albanian is an official language in North Macedonia and some government consultation material is issued bilingually.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a short Albanian-language pass (e.g. 'Banka Popullore e Republikës së Maqedonisë së Veriut', 'projektvendim', 'konsultim publik', 'afati për komente') against ENER and government portals.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial regulatory-tracker vendors with confirmed North Macedonia coverage remain unidentified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Contact Thomson Reuters Regulatory Intelligence, Corlytics, CUBE and Wolters Kluwer directly to confirm MK jurisdiction coverage and horizon-scanning depth before assuming a gap is permanent.

coverage_gaps.description: Local Skopje-based firms' own newsletters (e.g. Debarliev Dameski & Kelesoska, Polenak, Mens Legis, Lalicic & Partners, ODI Skopje) were only partially probed; their direct subscription feeds are likely faster than the aggregators that republish them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the top 8-10 MK banking/finance firms from Chambers, Legal 500 and CEE Legal Matters, then map each firm's insights/RSS endpoint and newsletter signup.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed recent FSAP means periodic deep supervisory assessment coverage for MK is thin between annual EC reports.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Verify MK's FSAP cycle status directly on the IMF FSSA index and in the latest Article IV; if none is scheduled, weight the EC enlargement report and MONEYVAL follow-ups as the primary periodic assessments.

coverage_gaps.description: No Macedonian-language legal-bulletin or consultancy-tracker service was located within this cell's scope.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated mk-language pass on terms such as 'правен билтен', 'новости од регулативата', 'адвокатска канцеларија банкарско право' and check whether MK firms publish bilingual feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: Consultations specifically — English aggregators report adopted laws and application dates well, but rarely open consultation windows or draft-law comment periods.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with a national-portal cell (NBRNM, ENER/e-consultation portal, mchamber.mk draft-law postings) since the English layer is a lagging indicator for consultation deadlines.

coverage_gaps.description: State-owned and para-state entities that are heavy payments/cash consumers were not individually scouted: Македонска пошта (postal payments/counters), Фонд за ПИОМ (pension payouts), Агенција за вработување, ЕВН/state utilities, Централен регистар, and municipal treasuries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second pass enumerating contracting authorities from the ESJN institution grid and the uslugi.gov.mk register, then score each for payments/card/ATM/POS relevance rather than scouting them ad hoc.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code list was fixed for this cell, so neither the TED nor the ESJN collector has a precise filter yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define the CPV set (e.g. 30123400 cash dispensers/ATMs, 30144200 ticket/card machines, 30162000 smart cards, 48xxxxxx banking/financial software, 66xxxxxx financial services, 72xxxxxx IT services, 79xxxxxx audit/compliance) and validate it against a sample of historical MK awards before productionising.

coverage_gaps.description: IFI coverage is partial: EBRD, World Bank and EU/IPA were scouted, but EIB, Council of Europe Development Bank, UNDP/UNOPS MK procurement, KfW, USAID successors and Swiss SECO channels were not.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout UNDP/UNOPS MK country procurement pages and the EIB/CEB notice feeds in a follow-up pass; UNOPS in particular was flagged as funding large MK projects.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) procurement publication was not searched at all; MK publishes some official content bilingually.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sq glossary terms (prokurim publik, njoftim për kontratë, tender) and re-run discovery over the same portals, plus municipal authorities in Albanian-majority municipalities.

coverage_gaps.description: Several candidate URLs are inferred entry points (TED search page, ECEPP notice list, dkzjn.gov.mk root, data.gov.mk dataset filters) rather than pages fetched and confirmed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic liveness pass resolve these; where a root resolves but the deep listing path differs, re-derive the listing URL from the live site's own navigation rather than guessing.

coverage_gaps.description: Foreign parent-group IT suppliers of MK bank subsidiaries (NLB Group for NLB Banka, OTP for Ohridska/Sparkasse successor entities, Halkbank TR, Ziraat TR, ProCredit Holding, Steiermärkische/Sparkasse) were not searched. Group-level vendor announcements often cover the MK subsidiary implicitly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second pass over parent-group press rooms and their vendors' regional case studies, searching in sl, hr, sr, tr and de as well as en.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor job advertisements and bank IT job ads (which name the exact platform being implemented and the deadline) were not searched; nor were conference agendas and speaker lists (MBA events, MicroBalkans, KIBS/NBRM conferences).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a recurring sweep of vlemi.mk / vrabotuvanje.com.mk / LinkedIn Jobs for platform names, and of MK banking conference agendas where bank CIOs present live projects.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) sources were not covered at all in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Repeat the seed queries in Albanian and check MK Albanian-language business media for bank technology announcements.

coverage_gaps.description: MK company/contract registries (Central Registry crm.com.mk) were not queried to link vendor legal entities to bank-related activity or to identify newly incorporated vendor subsidiaries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate crm.com.mk search interfaces and terms of use for entity lookup on the vendor registry built from MASIT.

coverage_gaps.description: Card-scheme and infrastructure-side sources (Mastercard/Visa regional press, EBA CLEARING / ECB TIPS Western Balkans roll-out communications) were only glimpsed via one ECB item and not systematically mapped, although they announce MK participation and deadlines.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ECB MIP news, TIPS Western Balkans roll-out pages and scheme regional press rooms as a dedicated monitoring set.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank PSPs, e-money institutions and payment institutions licensed under the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems were not individually enumerated; their career pages and training activity are unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the NBRSM register of licensed payment institutions / EMIs and add each entity's careers and news pages to the crawl list.

coverage_gaps.description: Recruitment agencies and outsourced compliance-staffing providers operating in Skopje (a common route for niche regulatory-reporting roles) were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search MK recruitment agency sites and pazar3.mk-style classifieds for compliance/reporting mandates; verify each domain before recording.

coverage_gaps.description: Job ads on MK boards are removed at the application deadline, so no historical series of posting volumes exists unless snapshots are taken.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Start daily snapshotting of listing pages now and back-fill via Wayback Machine where available, so that a hiring-surge baseline can be computed.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage of vacancies, seminars and certification announcements is absent.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sq glossary terms (shpallje pune, oficer i pajtueshmërisë, parandalimi i pastrimit të parave, trajnim) and rerun the cell in Albanian.

coverage_gaps.description: The highest-signal training agendas (MBA member seminars, in-house bank academies, vendor-run workshops) appear to be distributed privately rather than published.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use proxies — ABIT public catalogue, Chamber seminar calendar, MASIT/KIBS workshops, IORRM CPD programme PDFs — and treat any single published agenda as a rare confirming datapoint.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the 2022 edition of the NBRM 'Извештај за поплаките примени во банките и штедилниците' was surfaced by search. The full back-series and the most recent editions (2023-2025) were not located, and the canonical index page that lists them was 403-blocked.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the NBRM consumer-information and news indices with a headless browser to enumerate all editions; build a per-year time series of complaint counts by product and complaint type.

coverage_gaps.description: No specific Administrative, Higher Administrative, Supreme or Constitutional Court judgment concerning banking or payment-services fees was actually identified in this slice — only the registers where such judgments would live, plus generic Constitutional Court case permalinks whose subject matter was not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted browser-driven pass over ustavensud.mk/мк/одлуки-и-решенија with the query facet set to банк / надоместок / провизија / платежни услуги / кредит, and over the sud.mk ОДЛУКИ modules; record case numbers (У.бр., УII.бр.) and the cited provisions.

coverage_gaps.description: The only confirmed State Audit Office audit of the National Bank found is the 2015 regularity audit. Whether DZR has since audited the NBRM's supervisory function, or audited it on a performance (not merely regularity) basis, is unestablished.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query the DZR report index with the entity facet set to Народна банка and scan the annual DZR programme (годишна програма за работа) for planned financial-sector audits.

coverage_gaps.description: The Ministry of Finance's role as supervisor of financial companies (fast loans, leasing) — flagged by ОПМ as the complaint destination for that segment — was not itself scouted, nor was the Insurance Supervision Agency. Both sit adjacent to this cell's payments/banking scope.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout finance.gov.mk for financial-company supervision, registers and complaint handling; treat as an adjacent-cell handoff if outside this slice's boundary.

coverage_gaps.description: Провизии.мк appears to be a bank-fee comparison portal but its operator, legal basis (whether it discharges a statutory fee-transparency obligation under the payment services law), and terms of use are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the portal's about/legal pages and check whether the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems mandates a comparison site; establish scraping permissibility before any structured collection.

coverage_gaps.description: No Albanian-language (sq) searching was performed, per run scope. Regional consumer organisations and bilingual institutional output in Albanian remain uncovered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If run scope can be widened, repeat the grievance-channel queries in Albanian (mbrojtja e konsumatorit, ankesë, Banka Popullore, Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit, Avokati i Popullit).

coverage_gaps.description: No measurement of how well the Wayback Machine actually captures nbrm.mk .nspx pages and linked PDFs (snapshot frequency, whether PDFs are archived at all).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: From the deterministic pipeline, run CDX queries per watched NBRM URL with collapse=digest and count distinct versions per year; if coverage is thin, stand up an in-run snapshotting step (Save Page Now push + local PDF hashing) as the primary provenance mechanism.

coverage_gaps.description: No systematic probe was possible for feed endpoints on the .gov.mk CMS estate (Umbraco-style ministries) or the .nspx sites — /feed, /rss, /wp-json, sitemap.xml were not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a mechanical feed-probe step over every candidate domain (sitemap.xml, /feed, /rss, /wp-json/wp/v2/posts, <link rel=alternate> parsing) — cheapest possible win for durable monitoring endpoints.

coverage_gaps.description: Securities and Exchange Commission (Комисија за хартии од вредност), MAPAS (Агенција за супервизија на капитално финансирано пензиско осигурување), the Deposit Insurance Fund (Фонд за осигурување на депозити), the Macedonian Stock Exchange (МСЕ), the Central Registry (Централен регистар) and KIBS/clearing infrastructure were identified as relevant actors but no candidate URL was verified for them in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball from the NBRM 'other institutions' page (URL captured above) to harvest each body's canonical domain, then repeat this cell's archive/feed/dataset triage for each.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell brief explicitly includes web-archive snapshots of BANK pages (tariffs, T&Cs, general conditions), but no individual commercial bank domain (Komercijalna, Stopanska, NLB, Halkbank, ProCredit, Sparkasse, UNIBanka, Silk Road Bank etc.) was enumerated or archive-checked in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the bank domain list from https://www.nbrm.mk/banki.nspx, then CDX-index each bank's tariff/general-conditions URLs — these are the pages most often silently replaced and are the evidence base for proving when a fee or term changed.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage was not attempted. Albanian is an official language in North Macedonia and some government/consultation material is published in Albanian, but the run scope specified only mk and en.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If scope allows, add sq-language queries (e.g. 'Regjistri Kombëtar Elektronik i Rregulloreve', 'Banka Popullore e Republikës së Maqedonisë së Veriut') to catch Albanian-only postings of consultations.

coverage_gaps.description: The NBStat PxWeb API base path and version were inferred from standard PxWeb conventions rather than read off a documented endpoint; the portal root page showed no API link.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe https://nbstat.nbrm.mk/pxweb/api/v1/en/ (and /mk/) to confirm the API root, then persist the table tree so revisions to supervisory/monetary series can be diffed run over run.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact index/search URLs inside slvesnik.com.mk for browsing issues by number and year, and for the free-access acts database, were not resolved because the site could not be fetched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-attempt with a browser-grade fetcher and a permissive CA bundle; map the issue-index URL pattern and record whether a free full-text search exists alongside the paid subscription.

coverage_gaps.description: Individual committee pages for Комисија за финансирање и буџет and Комисија за економски прашања were not resolved to concrete URLs, only the committee index.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl rabotni-tela.nspx with a browser-grade fetcher to extract per-committee ids and sitting lists, and confirm which committee is матично for banking vs payment-services bills.

coverage_gaps.description: Searching was done in Macedonian and English only. Albanian is an official language in RNM and gazette/parliament material is published in Albanian too; no Albanian-language search was run and no Albanian glossary (ligj, projektligj, Fletorja Zyrtare, Kuvendi) was exercised.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an Albanian pass with terms 'projektligj për bankat', 'ligji për shërbimet e pagesave', 'Kuvendi i Republikës së Maqedonisë së Veriut', to check for Albanian-language editions or earlier/parallel publication.

coverage_gaps.description: No source was found that publishes transition/entry-into-force deadlines as structured data; they exist only as prose in преодни и завршни одредби of each statute.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define an extraction rule set over gazette PDFs for 'влегува во сила ... ден од денот на објавувањето' and 'ќе се применува од' patterns, and validate it against the Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи (Сл. весник 90/2022, application from 1.1.2023) as a known-answer test case.

coverage_gaps.description: The full amendment chronology for the core statutes (Закон за банките, Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи, ЗСППФТ, Закон за девизното работење) was only partially observed — individual gazette issues surfaced (90/2022, 208/2024, 37/2025, and a consolidated PSPS text versioned 267-25) but no complete chain was assembled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the per-statute amendment ledger from the consolidated texts on nbrm.mk and ufr.gov.mk (their headers list all amending gazette issues), then verify each against the gazette itself.

coverage_gaps.description: Licence and API terms for AKADEMIKA and for the Службен весник publisher's subscription database were not established; both are behind registration.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Contact both vendors for pricing and machine-access terms before designing collection; do not scrape either pending a licence.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed URL for the KZK concentration-notification listing/decision archive; the notification about ALTA GROUP acquiring control over Stopanska banka Bitola was visible only as a search snippet, and the site uses year-archive paths of unclear structure.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch kzk.gov.mk homepage and its year archives directly to map the notification and decision URL patterns; add mk keyword filters банка / платежен / картич.

coverage_gaps.description: The UJP register of approved fiscal systems and its type-approval decisions were not located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl ujp.gov.mk with site-restricted mk queries ('регистар на одобрени фискални системи', 'одобрение за производство и продажба на фискална апаратура') and, failing that, submit an FOI request via the ASPI-listed UJP information officer.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) versions of these authorities' sites were not explored, although MK authorities publish bilingually (e.g. ASO's bilingual naming 'Agjencia e Mbikëqyrjes së Sigurimeve').
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sq to the language set for a follow-up pass; sq pages sometimes carry documents absent from the mk tree and vice versa.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom or structured API endpoint was identified for any of the six authorities; all candidates are currently HTML/PDF scrape targets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe likely feed paths (/feed/, /rss, ?feed=rss2) on the WordPress-based sites (aso.mk, azlp.mk, ufr.gov.mk, kzk.gov.mk) during the verification pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent non-central-bank bodies that also impose payments-relevant obligations were not covered in this cell: Агенција за електронски комуникации (АЕК), Агенција за пошти (postal payment services), and Државен завод за ревизија. AEK and AP surfaced incidentally in searches.
